dct_title_s: Pierhead 8c Bulkhead Lines on Delaware River Vicinity of Mantua Creek
dct_description_sm: Map covers Delaware River from Mantua Creek to Green Tree.
Map shows Mantua Creek, Little Mantua Creek, an application for Riparian Grant and locations of lines recommended by the War Department.
